label: Proton
description: The Proton build umu-run starts the game with.

label: Esync
description: Wine's eventfd synchronisation; faster, on for most games.

label: Fsync
description: Futex synchronisation; needs a kernel with futex2, faster than esync.

label: NTSync
description: The kernel's NT synchronisation driver; needs Linux 6.14 and a Proton built for it.

label: Wayland
description: Proton's own Wayland driver instead of Xwayland; dropped inside gamescope unless it exposes Wayland.

label: HDR
description: HDR output: Proton's PROTON_ENABLE_HDR, and --hdr-enabled on gamescope.

label: DLSS upgrade
description: Swap the game's DLSS for the latest the driver ships.

label: FSR 4 upgrade
description: Swap the game's FSR for FSR 4; RDNA 4, or RDNA 3 with Proton's override.

label: XeSS upgrade
description: Swap the game's XeSS for the latest.

label: OptiScaler
description: Run OptiScaler: FSR 4 or XeSS where the game only offers DLSS.

label: Wine prefix
description: The Wine prefix the game runs in; empty: <prefixes_root>/<id>.

label: MangoHud
description: Show MangoHud's overlay in the game.

label: Frame rate limit
description: MangoHud holds the game to this many frames per second, overlay or not; auto is the refresh rate the game sees.

label: Pause on HOME
description: Freeze the game while the launcher covers it, so the pad drives the menu alone; it runs again on Resume. Off for a game that must keep running (online play).

label: Wrapper command
description: A command the game runs through, innermost: gamemoderun, taskset -c 0-7…

label: Arguments
description: Arguments appended to the game's command line.

label: Working directory
description: The folder the game starts in.

label: Gamescope
description: Run the game inside a gamescope of its own; a launcher already inside gamescope puts it on that one instead.

label: Resolution
description: What the game renders at; auto is the screen's own. Lower is upscaled to the screen.

label: Refresh rate
description: The refresh rate the game sees; auto is the screen's own.

label: Scaler
description: How a smaller picture fills the screen: integer keeps pixels whole, fit keeps the aspect, fill and stretch do not.

label: Filter
description: The upscaling filter: fsr and nis sharpen, nearest and pixel keep pixel art crisp.

label: Sharpness
description: For fsr and nis: 0 is sharpest, 20 softest.

label: Adaptive sync
description: Variable refresh rate when the screen supports it.

label: Arguments
description: Extra gamescope flags, after and over the fields above.
